name: Wideframe
long_description:
We help video teams deliver better edits, faster.

Video editing is going the way of software engineering. It’s becoming AI-native, and that shift is elevating today’s editors into creative strategists, producers, and orchestrators of AI agents.

Our co-founder and CEO wrote about this shift here: https://danielpearson.substack.com/p/how-ai-took-my-job

We build for teams, not solo creators. Our customers produce episodic content for TV and YouTube, juggle multiple client deadlines, or run high-volume commercial content inside brands.

For our customers, videos are never done. They’re just due. We help with the work in between.
one_liner: We help video teams deliver better edits, faster.
